svg.title: Legislative Library Digital Collections header
svg.desc: Website composition rebuilt with the Assembly dome from the February 2024 report cover and all three lines of lettering traced from the published PNG. Website reference https://digitalcollections.llbc.leg.bc.ca/assets/custom/images/LibraryLogo.png. Dome vector source https://www.leg.bc.ca/sites/default/files/images/pdf/clerk/WGPC-Report_February-2024.pdf#page=1.
